name: RethinkFirst
one_liner: RethinkFirst sells RethinkCare, an employer benefit with training and coaching for working parents and caregivers, including of autistic children.
best_for: Working parents and caregivers of autistic or neurodivergent children who want parent training videos and courses
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
Families looking to start ABA therapy directly (go through an ABA provider and your insurance)
People whose employer does not offer RethinkCare
short_description: Employer-paid benefit (RethinkCare) for parents and caregivers, plus ABA practice software. Families cannot buy it or get ABA from it directly.
long_description: RethinkFirst is a company that sells behavioral health software and programs to organisations rather than to families. Its RethinkCare product is an employer-sponsored benefit for working parents, caregivers and neurodivergent employees: online courses, video skills training based on behavioral principles, and, depending on the employer, one-on-one sessions with its neurodiversity experts and help finding in-network providers. RethinkCare says it is not an EAP. Its RethinkBH product is practice-management and billing software used by ABA providers; RethinkFirst does not itself deliver ABA therapy to families. To use RethinkCare you need an employer that offers it; families seeking ABA therapy go through an ABA provider and their insurance.

pricing.starting_price: Employer benefit only (RethinkCare); not sold to individuals
pricing.notes: Paid for by employers; no individual price is published. RethinkBH is software sold to ABA practices, not to families. ABA therapy itself is billed by your ABA provider to your insurance.

privacy.notes: Policy says Rethink will never sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. Deletion rights and HIPAA status for RethinkCare not confirmed (Rethink cites HITRUST certification, a security framework). RethinkCare has its own notice. No regulatory action found.

seo.meta_description: RethinkFirst (now part of CareFirst) provides ABA therapy and autism services for children, plus mental health support for employees and families.

faqs.a: Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is an evidence-based treatment for autism that focuses on developing communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing challenging behaviors. RethinkFirst provides ABA through trained therapists working with children and families.

faqs.q: How do I access RethinkFirst autism services?
faqs.a: RethinkFirst autism services are typically accessed through insurance coverage or employer benefits. Some insurance plans cover ABA therapy. Contact RethinkFirst or check with your insurance to verify coverage and access the autism services program.

faqs.q: Does RethinkFirst offer employee mental health benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, RethinkFirst provides employee mental health programs including digital wellness tools, counseling access, and family support resources. If your employer offers RethinkFirst, check your benefits portal for available services.

Yes, ABA therapy is one of the most researched and effective treatments for autism. RethinkFirst's programs are designed by behavior analysts and follow evidence-based ABA principles. Their digital tools supplement clinical treatment.

primary_uses: Video-based parent training using behavioral (ABA) principles
Online courses for working parents and caregivers

patient_summary: You can use RethinkCare only if your employer offers it as a benefit; ask HR or your benefits team. It gives working parents and caregivers online courses and video skills training, and with some employers one-on-one expert support. It is not a way to get ABA therapy for your child; for that you need an ABA provider through your insurance.

availability.note: Only through employers that offer RethinkCare. Not available to individuals or families directly, and does not provide ABA therapy.
